info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Regions-v3-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Region Listing API provides users with access to a comprehensive list of regions where weather alerts are active. This endpoint allows consumers to retrieve vital information regarding geographic areas impacted by severe weather conditions. Typical users of this API include weather services, emergency management teams, and applications focused on providing real-time alerts to end-users. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can ensure timely communication of weather-related risks in their designated regions.

get.summary: Retrieve alerts for a specific region.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all alerts associated with a specific geographical region. Use this to monitor critical updates and incidents that may affect the designated area.

requestBody.description: Request body for fetching alerts by region. This payload allows the client to specify the necessary parameters to retrieve relevant alert data for the specified region.

200.description: Successfully retrieved alerts for the specified region.
